# Business Domain - Event-Driven Business Process Patterns

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../README.md) • [Patterns](../../README.md) • [Business](../README.md)**

This directory contains business process patterns using event-driven architecture within the **Business Domain**. These patterns focus on business workflows, process orchestration, and business capability implementation using event-driven approaches.
page_texts.2:
[patterns/business/event-driven/README.md#overview]

## Overview

Event-Driven Business Process patterns address:

- **Business Workflows**: Event-driven business process orchestration
- **Customer Integration**: Customer onboarding and lifecycle management
- **Process Automation**: Automated business processes triggered by events
- **Business Events**: Domain events representing business state changes
- **Cross-System Integration**: Business process integration across systems

## Pattern Maturity

This is an emerging category of patterns focused on implementing business capabilities using event-driven architecture. Additional patterns for care management, claims processing, and member services will be added as they mature.
page_texts.8:
[patterns/business/event-driven/README.md#future-patterns]

## Future Patterns

Planned pattern areas include:

- **Care Management**: Care coordination and case management workflows
- **Claims Processing**: Claims adjudication and payment processes
- **Member Services**: Member enrollment and eligibility workflows
- **Provider Management**: Provider onboarding and credentialing
